d: At a tent a concert of trumpets in the form of a battle, which follows by hand, by hand; in which time the curtain was lifted, it will be seen fenced out of the city of Jerusalem with sun, which sets at the occasion. Body of Christian soldiers on one side: of Saracens on the other. Pindorus, and Arideus the two godparents in the middle with their scepters in the hand. Erminia on the top of a tower within the walls, observing the outcome of the battles. Argette in action of having thrown to the ground Otto.
Tancredi with sword to hand and sayings.
Clorinda's rooms in the turquoise adjoining those of Erminia, with the armor of the same Clorinda hanging above.
Alindo, and Erminia.
Herminia alone.
Chlorinda with a cheerful look, and Ismeno.
Clorinda alone.
Finishing of forest with full moon, petiole hill on one side; Christian pavilions on the other in the distance. Herminia dressed with the armor of Clorinda, and Alindo her squire.
Herminia alone.
Alindo, returning from the camp.
Tancredi agitated talking to many Christian soldiers.
Go outside the city of Jerusalem with a little hill in the middle, below which I saw the cave of Ismen, and on one side Christian pavilions in the distance. Argante, and his Herald.
As the Herald sends to the Christian camp he is arrested by Clorinda, followed by many Turkish soldiers, leading him to Argante.
Argettes, and Clorinda in the distance.
Raimondo followed by a long line of Captains, and other Militias pre-empted by the Argent Herald.
Lesson out of the cave.
Clorinda, and Argante return with their people to the walls of Jerusalem.
Clorinda alone.
Flowered meadow, where the Jordan River passes with plane trees on the shore. Pastor, who guides the sheep to pasture, followed by three Children.
Erminia, and sayings.
Castle of Armida placed in the middle of a lake with drawbridge, which lowers to the sound of a Corriero, who arrives. Tancredi, and Corriero.
Hurry up, and Tancredi.
It illuminates the castle with starry sky, and machine, in which Armida is locked invisible. Rambaldo with the visor lowered descends from the bridge with naked sword on the right.
Tancredi lonely.
Clorinda, dressed in gloomy weapons, and Argante.
Ismen, and sayings.
Argettes, and Ismenus.
Ismeno.
Loco delicious with beech trees, and laurels, and rustic hotel. Erminia, who comes dancing with other Shepherds.
Alindo survives, when the Little Shepherds flee.

Christian camp with military tower over which there are the Guards, and Soldiers sleeping at the foot of that. Raimondo, who comes to the camp with Tancredi, and all the Captains, who were prisoners of Armida, freed from Rinaldo.
Tancredi, and Comrades.
Chlorinda, and Argantes with closed lights on the right followed by Ismeno.
Come back, Frightened Ismen.
Clorinda with the visor dropped chased by Tancredi.
Come back Tancredi with the helmet full of water.
Jerusalem suburbs, Herminia, and Alindo.
Argettes, Ismenus weeping, and sayings.
Ismen, and sayings.
Erminia, and Alindo.
Loco, where the tomb of Clorinda rises with her arms hung from the plant of a cypress. Tancredi, who comes to visit the said tomb.
Clorinda's spirit over a bunch of clouds.
Tancredi taking refuge, and then Raimondo.
Raimondo looking behind Tancredi.
Selva in the form of an amphitheatre with the plant of a cypress in the middle.
Tancredi with sword to the hand enters the enchanted forest coming out flames everywhere.
A ghost in the form of Chlorinda comes out of that cypress tree.
Even the Monsters disappeared, Tancredi found himself in a countryside, where Argante came.
Tancredi, and Argante dead.
Erminia, and Alindo, and sayings.
Jerusalem Square with burning stake in the middle. Raimondo, and Soldiers, who keep Ismen imprisoned.
Alindo, Raimondo, and then Tancredi, Erminia over majestic chariot pulled by Turkish slaves on the eminence of which Godfrey triumphant.
